name: LaunchDarkly
summary: LaunchDarkly is a hosted feature flag service with a free Developer plan and a usage-based Foundation plan. Foundation has no seat or platform fee and bills $10 per service connection per month plus client-side monthly active users. Advanced targeting, approvals and SCIM sit on the quoted Enterprise plan.

facts.text: The Developer plan lists unlimited seats and flags, 5 service connections and 1K client-side monthly active users, with 14 days of data retention for AgentControl.
The pricing page shows Foundation client-side usage at $8.33 per 1K monthly active users in the plan card and $10 per 1K in the comparison table.
Workflows, approvals, custom roles and SCIM provisioning are listed under Enterprise, not Foundation.
Server-side SDKs include Go, Java, Python, Ruby, PHP and Rust, and client-side SDKs include JavaScript, React Native, Android, iOS and Flutter.

plans.name: Developer
plans.notes: No credit card required. The page shows $ without naming a currency

plans.name: Foundation
plans.notes: Billed yearly, pay as you go, 14-day trial. Also $8.33 per 1K client-side monthly active users (the comparison table says $10) and $5 per extra 1K AI runs. 5 service connections are included. The page shows $ without naming a currency

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Custom pricing. An Enterprise trial is offered, with no length stated

hiddenCosts: Guardian, for release monitoring and automatic rollback, is a separately priced add-on.
